guide.entry.domixs-creatures.arapaima_pa: The arapaima can be found in tropical biomes, like the mangrove swamp or the jungle.
Over time, the arapaima can lose some of its scales, which can be used to make the arapaima armor.
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.beaver_page: The beaver can be found around the beaver house structure in the forest. There are always 3 beavers per beaver house.
Beaver houses are made from piles of sticks. If you break a naturally generated one, you have a chance to find a water lily, which can be used to breed the beavers.
The beaver will pick a nearby pile of sticks as its home position and will stay in a 16 block radius around the block.
If you bring the beaver 26 blocks from its home position, it will forget that position and wander randomly, until it finds a new pile of sticks.
If the beaver gets near a Log, it can strip it. When this happens, it will drop bark and has a chance, to drop sawdust.
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.bison_page1: The bison can be found in grassy biomes, like plains and meadows.
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.bison_page2: A bison will only attack if its babies are nearby.
If you stand near an adult bison for too long, it will charge at you.
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.bison_page3: They can be bred with wheat.
If killed, the bison will drop bison meat and leather.
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.boar_page1_: The boar can be found in taiga biomes.
A boar will only attack if its babies are nearby.
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.boar_page2: Occasionally, you can see boars digging in taiga Biomes. There's a 30% chance they will dig up an item, and a 50% chance that item will be a truffle.
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.boar_page3_: Truffles can be used to breed boars.
If killed, the boar will drop porkchop.
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.deer_page1: The deer can be found in the taiga biome.
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.deer_page2_: Deer will eventually shed their antlers, which can be collected.
The antlers will regrow back to their original size after a while.
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.deer_page3_: There are three sizes of antlers: Small, Medium, Large.
If a deer is killed, it will drop 2 antlers of the corresponding size and raw deer venison.
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.deer_page4: 2 antlers of the same size can be combined with 1 Leather to craft wearable antlers.
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.deer_page5_: Deer can be bred using wheat.
They can only breed if one has antlers and the other does not.
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.butterfly_p: The butterfly can be found in jungle, forest, and plains biomes.
There are 10 variants in total, all dependent on the biome the butterfly spawned in.
Butterflies can be bred with small flowers.
When bred, the butterflies spawn a caterpillar.
Over time, the caterpillar will cocoon itself and after a while, will become a butterfly.
When the caterpillar transforms, it will drop 1-3 silk.
After pollinating a flower, the butterfly will look for nearby crops. If it finds a crop, it will also pollinate it, causing it to grow by one stage.
If the butterfly doesn't pollinate a crop, it will eventually lose the pollen it got from the flower.
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.capybara_pa: The capybara can be found in swamps and mangrove swamps.
When near a capybara that's in water, tamed creatures will gain the regeneration effect.
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.raccoon_pag: The raccoon can be found in taiga biomes. It will steal food items from nearby chests.
Once a raccoon steals food, it will try to find water to wash and eat it.
When it steals and eats 3 marshmallows, it will get tamed by the nearest player.
Raccoons can be bred by manually feeding them marshmallows.
They will try to steal the following food:
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.unicorn_pag: The unicorn can be found in plains, meadows, and flower forest biomes during a clear full moon.
Unicorns are extremely timid and will run away if they see you not sneaking or with a weapon.
They can be tamed with a golden apple, after which they can be fed golden carrots to increase the trust towards their owner (max 10)
Once tamed, the unicorn will occasionally rub its horn on nearby trees.
When it does this, there is a chance for it to drop unicorn dust. This chance gets increased by 20% for every trust level.
If you have a tamed, fully trusting unicorn near you, other wild unicorns will no longer run away.
If you hit your tamed unicorn, it will lose 1 trust point for each hit.
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.hermit_crab: The hermit crab can be found in the beach biome.
Hermit crabs are easily scared and will hide in their shell if you run near them.
They can be traded with 20 times per day using golden nuggets.
The following items can be acquired from trading:
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.rat_page1: The rat can be found around villages. Wild rats will occasionally break grown crops.
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.rat_page2: They can be bred with carrots, and tamed with cheese, and will attack with their owner.
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.rat_page3: A command flute can be used to command all nearby rats to sit/follow their owner.
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.penguin_pag: The penguin can be found in snowy plains, snowy beach, ice spikes, and frozen ocean biomes.
They can be bred with raw cod.
Once bred one of the penguins will place an egg on one of the following blocks:
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.cave_wyvern: The cave wyvern can be found deep under swamp, mangrove swamp, and jungle biomes.
It is very sensitive to sunlight. If exposed to it for long enough, the wyvern will eventually turn pale and start running to shade to avoid taking damage.
The wyvern has a powerful poison bite and can breathe poison gas at its targets.
If killed, the wyvern drops its scales, which can be used to craft the wyvern scale armor.
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.iguana_page: The iguana can be found in jungle biomes.
Iguanas can be seen basking in the sun during noon.
They can be bred with apples and tamed with jungle leaves.
Once tamed, the iguana can be commanded to sit or follow using a stick.
It can also be equipped on the shoulder with §6§lright-click§r using an empty hand (1 per shoulder)
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.termite_pag: The termite can be found in savanna and jungle biomes, around termite hills.
There are three types of termite: Queen, Soldier, Worker.
The queen is always inside the nest and can only be seen by breaking the nest block.
If the queen's nest is broken, it will slowly move around trying to look for a new empty nest.
The workers will look for nearby logs.
Once a worker finds a log, it will eat the inside of it, bringing sawdust back to the nest.
Once a worker termite eats the inside of a log, it can be mined to get a hollow log block.
The soldiers will wander around the hill and will attack ants that get near, or anything that attacks the termites.
If the soldier gets below half health, it will retreat inside the nest to regenerate.
Termites can be collected with the glass jar.
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.ant_page1: Ants can be found in taiga and jungle biomes, around ant hills.
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.ant_page2_l: There are three types of ant: Queen, Soldier, Worker.
The queen is always inside the nest and can only be seen by breaking the nest block.
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.ant_page3: If the queen's nest is broken, it will slowly move around trying to look for a new empty nest.
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.ant_page4_l: The workers will look for nearby leaves.
Once a worker finds leaves, it will break them and carry them back to the nest.
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.ant_page5: The soldiers will wander around the hill and will attack termites that get near, or anything that attacks the ants.
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.ant_page6: If the soldier gets below half health, it will retreat inside the nest to regenerate.
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.ant_page7: Ants can be collected with the glass jar.
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.worm_page1: The worm can be found in most temperate biomes.
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.worm_page2: It spawns during rain on the following blocks:
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.worm_page3: Worms can be collected with the glass jar, which then can be used on dirt and farmland blocks to turn them into a rich variant.
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.worm_page4: If killed, it drops the worm item, which can be eaten but has a chance to apply the hunger effect.
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.anteater_pa: The anteater can be found in jungle biomes.
It will attack any termites or ants nearby, but will stop attacking if its health gets below half.
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.coconut_pag: Coconuts can be found growing on palm trees in beach biomes. They can be knocked down with a projectile.
To split a coconut, simply §6§lright-click§r it with an axe. This will yield 2 coconut slices.
A coconut slice can be eaten, and it will remove one random effect from the player.
Once eaten, a coconut slice will turn into a coconut shell.
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.conch_shell: The conch shell can only be acquired by trading with hermit crabs.
Playing the conch shell with §6§lright-click§r will give you the ocean's blessing effect for 5 minutes.
The ocean's blessing effect causes the hermit crabs daily trade limit to increase by 5.
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.magnet_page: The magnet can be bound to any item and will either pull the bound item type to you or push it away.
To bind an item, simply §6§lright-click§r with the desired item on the magnet. To unbind it, §6§lright-click§r the magnet again.
To activate the magnet, hold §6§lright-click§r to pull and §6§lshift§r + §6§lright-click§r to push.
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.silk_page1: Silk can be acquired from a cocooned caterpillar, that transforms into a butterfly.
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.silk_page2: It can be used to craft a table cloth block.
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.copper_trum: The copper trumpet can be crafted from 5 copper ingots.
It will oxidize overtime, but the oxidization can be stopped at any phase by combining the trumpet with a honeycomb.
The copper trumpet will have a different sound based on what oxidization stage it is in.
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.macuahuitl_: The macuahuitl, an ancient weapon found in the aztec temple, has a 15% chance to apply bleeding on hit for 10 seconds.
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.unicorn_dus: Unicorn dust can be used on dirt-like blocks to turn them into grass blocks. It can also grow flowers and grass when used on grass blocks.
The following blocks can be converted to grass blocks by unicorn dust:
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.net_page1: The net can be crafted from 5 strings.
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.net_page2: It is used to craft the Bug Net item or the net block.
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.bug_net_pag: The bug net is crafted using 3 sticks and 4 nets.
It can be used with §6§lright-click§r to catch butterflies.
Once caught, the butterfly can be released again with §6§lright-click§r. When released, 1 durability will be removed from the bug net.
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.marshmallow: Marshmallow can be made using sugar and egg.
It can be put on a stick and cooked by holding §6§lright-click§r on a campfire.
If you hold it on the campfire for too long, the marshmallow will get burnt.
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.cheese_page: A cheese wheel can be crafted by combining 3 salt with 3 milk buckets.
The cheese wheel can be placed as a block. You can take cheese pieces from it using §6§lright-click§r.
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.magnet_bloc: There are two types of magnet blocks: negative and positive.
When powered by redstone, the negative magnet pushes iron items and entities with iron armor, while the positive magnet pulls them.
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.net_block_p: The net block can be crafted from 4 nets.
Landing on a net block cushions your fall and negates all fall damage.
The net block can be colored with any of the 16 dyes.
guide.entry.domixs-creatures.rich_dirt_p: Rich dirt can be made by collecting worms into a jar and putting them into normal dirt using §6§lright-click§r with the jar of worms.
It can be tilled with a hoe to make rich farmland. Any crop planted on rich farmland will grow twice as fast.
